## Featured Systems

### rust-stark-zkvm
Rust STARK zkVM with custom ISA, Winterfell proving/verification, HTTP/MCP interfaces and CI proof gates.
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/codesbyfebin/rust-stark-zkvm
- **Focus:** Verifiable computation, zero-knowledge proofs, cryptographic systems
- **Tech:** Rust, STARK proofs, Winterfell, HTTP/MCP interfaces
- **Status:** Production-ready research

### Decentralized.Host
Sovereign self-hosted infrastructure with signed intent, local admission, explicit state, Raft, WireGuard, chaos and conformance testing.
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/codesbyfebin/decentralized.host
- **Focus:** Infrastructure sovereignty, distributed systems, self-hosting
- **Tech:** Raft consensus, WireGuard, Docker, testing frameworks
- **Status:** Active development

### AI Infrastructure
Privacy-preserving AI deployment with verifiable compute guarantees.
- **Focus:** AI/ML infrastructure, privacy systems, secure enclaves
- **Tech:** Python, FastAPI, cryptographic protocols
- **Status:** Research & development

### Decentralized.hosting (Phase 1–2)
Self-hosted deployment mesh for distributed applications.
- **Focus:** Application deployment, orchestration, infrastructure
- **Tech:** FastAPI, Docker, Traefik, scheduling
- **Status:** Active development
